warnings.100_pct_win_rates: Several wallets show 100% win rate. While verified on-chain, this likely indicates: (1) Market making / delta-neutral strategies where 'winning' fills are part of a larger strategy, (2) Only closing profitable positions while leaving losers open (survivorship within fills), (3) Very tight TP with wide SL that hasn't been hit yet. These are NOT suitable for directional copy trading without understanding the full strategy.
warnings.low_wr_high_pnl: Traders like the $176M market maker (8.9% WR) and Auros ($65M, 22% WR) have low win rates because they use market-making strategies. Their fills are not directional signals.
warnings.exchange_verified_vs_onchain: Bybit/Bitget/OKX leaderboard stats are exchange-verified but NOT independently auditable. Hyperliquid and DEX data is fully on-chain and trustless.
warnings.named_whale_risk: Named whales (James Wynn, Machi) get publicity for big wins but often have massive drawdowns. Their strategies are high-variance and NOT suitable for systematic copy trading.
